method_card.title: Food, Drink and Meals
method_card.content:
This lesson covers food and drink vocabulary, mealtimes, expressing preferences with gustar-type verbs, and using the preterite tense to say what you ate.

SpanishEnglish
el desayunobreakfast
la comida / el almuerzolunch
la cenadinner
la meriendaafternoon snack
la manzanaapple
el pollochicken
el pescadofish
el arrozrice
las patatas fritaschips
la ensaladasalad
el quesocheese
me encantaI love (singular thing)
me gustaríaI would like
delicioso/adelicious
sabroso/a (Higher)tasty (Higher synonym for rico)

Grammar focus — gustar agreement: The verb gustar (and encantar) agrees with the thing liked, not the person. Use me gusta before a singular noun and me gustan before a plural noun. Me gusta el arroz (I like rice — singular), me gustan las patatas fritas (I like chips — plural). Spanish also requires the definite article: me gusta el queso, not me gusta queso.

Grammar focus — preterite: Use the preterite to say what you ate or drank. Regular -er/-ir preterite yo endings: comí, bebí, cené. Context words like ayer (yesterday) and anoche (last night) signal the preterite.

Model: Me encanta la paella porque es muy sabrosa. Para el desayuno como tostadas con mantequilla. Ayer cené pollo con arroz y estaba delicioso. (I love paella because it is very tasty. For breakfast I eat toast with butter. Yesterday I had chicken with rice for dinner and it was delicious.)
steps: Learn food and drink vocabulary across all categories
Know the four meals: desayuno, almuerzo / comida, merienda, cena
Use me gusta (singular) vs me gustan (plural) correctly — always with the definite article
Practice the preterite tense to say what you ate: comí, bebí, cené

exam_context.frequency: Core topic — food and mealtimes appear in every exam series

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: Me gustan las patatas fritas pero no me gusta el pescado.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Me gustan (plural) because las patatas fritas is plural. = I like chips.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: no me gusta (singular) because el pescado is singular. = I don't like fish.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: I like chips but I don't like fish.

worked_examples.question: Translate to Spanish: 'Yesterday I ate chicken with rice.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Yesterday = Ayer. I ate = comí (preterite of comer, yo form — note the accent on the í).

bronze.question: Match the Spanish food words to their English meaning
Match the Spanish meal words to their English meaning

gaps.correct_explain: encanta (singular) because la paella is singular. Me encanta = I love.

wrong.encantan: encantan is plural. La paella is singular → me encanta.
wrong.encanto: encanto is not how gustar-type verbs work. The verb agrees with the thing liked, not the person.

gaps.correct_explain: sabrosa agrees with la paella (feminine). The -a ending matches the feminine noun.
normalmente = normally. Frequency adverbs show routine habits.

wrong.normal: normal is an adjective, not an adverb. You need the adverb → normalmente.

gaps.rule: Present tense — yo form of beber
gaps.correct_explain: bebo is the yo form of beber (to drink) in the present tense.

wrong.bebe: bebe is the él/ella form. The subject is 'I' → bebo.
wrong.bebí: bebí is preterite (I drank). The sentence describes a routine → present tense bebo.

bronze.question: What does 'Ayer cené pescado con patatas fritas y estaba riquísimo' mean?
options: Yesterday I had fish with chips for dinner and it was really delicious
Yesterday I had breakfast with fish and it was horrible
Today I am eating fish with salad and it is delicious
Yesterday I cooked fish with chips but it was disgusting

bronze.question: Which sentence correctly uses gustar with a plural noun?

bronze.source_text: Para el desayuno como tostadas con mermelada. A mediodía almuerzo en el instituto.
model_answers: For breakfast I eat toast with jam. At midday I have lunch at school.

silver.question: Complete the sentence
silver.english: Yesterday I ate paella and drank lemonade. It was very tasty.

gaps.correct_explain: comí is the preterite yo form of comer. Ayer (yesterday) triggers the preterite.

wrong.como: como is present tense. Ayer (yesterday) requires the preterite → comí.
wrong.comió: comió is the él/ella form. The subject is 'I' → comí.

gaps.correct_explain: bebí is the preterite yo form of beber.

wrong.bebió: bebió is the él/ella form. Subject is 'I' → bebí.

gaps.correct_explain: sabrosa — the implied subject is la paella (feminine), or la comida.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: Me gusta las patatas fritas porque son deliciosas.
silver.explanation: Las patatas fritas is plural, so the verb must be gustan (not gusta). Gustar agrees with the thing liked.
silver.translation: I like chips because they are delicious.

silver.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
silver.english: I would like to try the Spanish omelette.

distractor_labels.español: wrong gender — tortilla is feminine, so española not español

silver.source_text: I love Spanish food. My favourite dish is paella because it is very tasty.
model_answers: Me encanta la comida española. Mi plato favorito es la paella porque es muy sabrosa.

silver.question: Listen and type what you hear
silver.audio_text: Ayer cené pescado con arroz y estaba muy rico.
silver.correct_text: Ayer cené pescado con arroz y estaba muy rico.
silver.translation: Yesterday I had fish with rice for dinner and it was very delicious.

silver.question: Put these words in the correct order to form a sentence

gold.source_text: I love Spanish food, especially paella and tapas. For breakfast I normally eat toast and drink orange juice. Yesterday I had fish with chips for dinner and it was really delicious. I would like to try more Spanish food.
model_answers: Me encanta la comida española, especialmente la paella y las tapas. Para el desayuno normalmente como tostadas y bebo un zumo de naranja. Ayer cené pescado con patatas fritas y estaba riquísimo. Me gustaría probar más comida española.
gold.ai_system_prompt: You are a GCSE Spanish examiner marking a translation about food and mealtimes. Source: '{source}'. Model answer: '{model}'. Check: gustar construction (article + noun), preterite tense, conditional me gustaría, adjective agreement. Respond in JSON: {"quality":"excellent|good|needs_work|not_valid","feedback":"2-3 sentences","improvement":"optional correction"}

gold.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
gold.english: Last weekend I had churros with chocolate for breakfast and they were really delicious.

distractor_labels.desayuno: wrong tense — desayuno is present. 'Last weekend' needs preterite → desayuné
distractor_labels.estaba: wrong number — estaba is singular. Churros is plural → estaban
distractor_labels.riquísimo: wrong number — riquísimo is singular. Churros is plural → riquísimos

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are in a restaurant in Spain with your family. The waiter comes to take your order.

bullets.prompt: Greet the waiter and ask for a table for four.
bullets.model_answer: ¡Buenas tardes! ¿Tiene una mesa para cuatro personas, por favor?

bullets.prompt: Order your food and a drink.
bullets.model_answer: Me gustaría la paella, por favor. Y para beber, un zumo de naranja.
bullets.note: me gustaría + food item + para beber + drink

bullets.prompt: Say what you thought of the food and give your opinion.
bullets.model_answer: La paella estaba riquísima. Me encanta la comida española.
bullets.note: imperfect estaba for description + opinion with me encanta

bullets.model_answer: ¿Me puede traer la cuenta, por favor?
bullets.note: la cuenta = the bill. Polite request with ¿Me puede...?

gold.question: Listen and type what you hear
gold.audio_text: Me encanta la comida española, especialmente la paella y las tapas. Ayer cené pescado con patatas fritas y estaba riquísimo.
gold.correct_text: Me encanta la comida española, especialmente la paella y las tapas. Ayer cené pescado con patatas fritas y estaba riquísimo.
gold.translation: I love Spanish food, especially paella and tapas. Yesterday I had fish with chips for dinner and it was really delicious.

gold.source_text: We have dinner as a family at eight in the evening. Last night we had an Italian meal and it was delicious.
model_answers: Cenamos en familia a las ocho de la noche. Anoche cenamos una comida italiana y estaba deliciosa.
